title: CWE-78 OS Command Injection
preconditions: 外部输入进入 OS 命令执行路径
dangerous_transitions: 外部输入进入 OS 命令执行路径
counterevidence: A guard dominates the sensitive operation for every relevant path.
The effective principal cannot control the source or the impact is not security relevant.
命令构造与执行分离; 参数数组优先
verification_recipe: Trace the relevant source cue to the system/popen/exec 族调用点 operation.
Establish attacker control, effective principal, guards, and security impact.
Test the listed counterevidence and record source anchors for every edge.
